title: U.S. Officially Enters Recession After GDP Contracts in Q2
description_short: U.S. Officially Enters Recession After GDP Contracts in Q2
description_medium: The U.S. economy officially entered a recession in August 2025 after the GDP contracted sharply in the second quarter. Economists directly attributed the downturn to the chaotic implementation of mass deportations, tariff wars, and the gutting of federal agencies. The economic collapse led to massive job losses and widespread financial panic.

title: Trump Rescinds Biden Clean Energy IRA Tax Credits
description_short: Trump Rescinds Biden Clean Energy IRA Tax Credits
description_medium: In 2025, the Trump administration moved to rescind or defund clean-energy tax credits created by the Inflation Reduction Act, according to the supplied summary. The packet says the uncertainty affected planned solar, wind, battery and electric-vehicle investments, but does not identify which credits changed, whether cuts were enacted, or how committed projects were treated.

title: USAID Dismantled — 10,000 Workers Fired, 90-Country Programs Ended
description_short: USAID Dismantled — 10,000 Workers Fired, 90-Country Programs Ended
description_medium: An April 2025 Reuters report said the administration planned to dismiss all locally hired USAID workers and U.S. diplomats connected to the agency. It described a proposed workforce reduction, not the final number of people dismissed. The linked report does not establish the title’s 10,000-worker total or the claimed end of programs in 90 countries.
notes: Reuters returned HTTP 401. The linked headline concerns planned dismissals, while the packet lacks a final staffing count, evidence of programs ending in 90 countries, identified court orders and compliance, and named analyses for projected deaths.

title: EPA Rejects Chlorpyrifos Ban
description_short: EPA denied petitions to ban the pesticide chlorpyrifos, keeping the chemical on the market despite health concerns.
description_medium: The Environmental Protection Agency denied petitions seeking a ban on chlorpyrifos, an insecticide used on crops, leaving approved uses on the market. The decision came amid concerns about exposure and potential health effects. The agency’s specific reasoning and the scope of the uses it considered are not established in the account.
